main_text.head: AD ELISABETHAM SERENISS. Angliæ Reginam, Ode.
main_text.p:
QV anuis vetusto stemmate splendeas,
Regina, princeps optima principum,
Quacunque magnum sol per orbem
Flammiferos agitat iugales:

page.notes: Verse text in italic and roman mixed as printed; several lines are partly illegible due to faded ink and show-through on the right side, so some words are uncertain and not marked individually. Right margin shows faint stains only.
